claims_in_paper.claim_text: Across this literature, precipitation effects are estimated at aggregate spatial scales (network-wide, city-level, or at most corridor-level) .

A complementary extension is network vulnerability analysis: betweenness centrality under normal and extreme-weather scenarios would identify links whose rainfall degradation cascades into network-wide journey time losses, connecting these link-level estimates to system-level climate risk assessment
